title: Subject-Verb Agreement with Biology Nouns
objective: Students make verbs match singular, plural, and collective scientific subjects.
context: A group of bees ___ (visit/visits) here. The flowers in the park ___ (look/looks) bright.

items.prompt: Find the subject head noun in each sentence.
items.hint: Ignore the phrase after of, on or in.

items.prompt: Use singular agreement for “group”. Choose both verbs.
items.hint: Check whether the main noun is singular or plural.

items.prompt: Rewrite the second sentence with a singular subject.
items.answer: The flower in the park looks bright.
items.hint: Check the noun and the verb again.
